environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Logs are written to /var/log/app/access.log and consumed by a Splunk Universal Forwarder configured with default line-breaking (props.conf LINE_BREAKER=(\r?\n)). The Splunk instance uses these logs for security alerting dashboards. Static assets served from the same origin via Gin's static file handler with no integrity verification enforced by the browser (Content-Security-Policy header is not set). No input sanitization middleware is configured.

config.logging_pipeline: Splunk UF -> Splunk Enterprise 8.2, default props.conf
